goal.objective: Deliver reliable local voice dictation that streams microphone-button input into OpenCode's normal message composer in real time, without a separate review popup or automatic sending, using only supported public plugin/extension APIs and leaving the installed OpenCode binary untouched: no binary patching, rebuilding, replacement or upgrade, no private TUI imports or simulated typing. Reuse and preserve the prior verified recognition source, session-race/privacy fixes and controlled acoustic evidence rather than repeating completed model experiments. Preserve existing drafts and attachments, partial-result revisions and concurrent edits, session routing, microphone placement after Ctrl+P commands, Ctrl+P voice settings, offline/in-memory audio, bounded resources, cancellation and cleanup. First verify whether a supported plugin-only composer route can satisfy these requirements on the unchanged host; if none exists, retain the full objective and report the concrete blocker rather than substitute a different UI or claim success. Verify source, approved loaded-runtime identity and actual human workflow separately. Give an explicit test phrase and verified Listening cue before any human speech test. Retain separate approval gates for dependency/model installation, native-config deployment, owned-TUI reload/shared restart, sending/publication and commit/push. Plan only while in Plan mode; implementation requires an explicit implementation request and switching to Build.

plan.summary: Preserve the verified recognition work, establish whether the unchanged OpenCode host has a supported plugin-only composer route, implement only if that gate passes, then verify source, approved runtime loading and the actual no-popup dictation workflow separately.
completionCriteria: Microphone-button speech streams into the normal OpenCode composer while speaking, without a separate review popup or automatic submission; only deliberate user Enter sends it.

The installed OpenCode executable retains its verified identity, version and byte hash: no patch, rebuild, replacement or upgrade. Only supported public plugin/extension APIs are used; no private TUI imports, host-renderable manipulation or simulated typing.

Complete known phrases, including testing one two three and please show me the files in this project, pass controlled acoustic and explicitly prompted human tests, with recognition faster than real time and no increasing backlog, early cutoff or missing suffix.

Streaming reconciles revised hypotheses without duplication and preserves pre-existing drafts, attachments and concurrent user edits; capture ownership is session/revision-bound and cannot target another session or dialog. Cancellation and unload do not discard unrelated user text.

The microphone stays at the far right after Ctrl+P commands, including available subagent-status transitions and narrow/wide layouts; Ctrl+P voice settings and truthful loading/listening/processing/error feedback remain.

Audio remains local/offline and in memory, buffers stay bounded, plugin-owned processes/threads/PipeWire nodes are released on cancellation/session change/unload, and system audio defaults, volume and security settings remain unchanged.

Relevant source checks pass and source, loaded-runtime and real-user acceptance are documented separately. No dependency/model install, native-config deployment, reload/shared restart, sending/publication, commit or push occurs without its required explicit authority.

Existing uncommitted work and prior verified recognition evidence are preserved. A missing plugin-only route is an explicit blocker, not grounds to claim success, weaken criteria, replace the normal composer, or repeat completed model experiments.
